# uzc_iso (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud ISO image sourced from a URL (POST /isos). Only `password_enabled`, `is_extractable`, and `is_bootable` are mutable in place (PUT /isos/{slug}/iso-permission); every other attribute forces recreation.

TODO(api): the spec also documents an `is_upload_from_local` binary upload flow that isn't implemented here, since it can't be exercised without a live account to test against.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_iso" "example" {
  cloud_provider           = "nimbo"
  name                     = "example-iso"
  os_type_id               = "23aec378-8d64-11ef-8ce4-000c298fabeb"
  image_type               = "Operating System"
  operating_system         = "ubuntu"
  operating_system_version = "22.04 LTS"
  billing_cycle            = "hourly"
  url                      = "https://releases.ubuntu.com/22.04/ubuntu-22.04.4-desktop-amd64.iso"
  is_bootable              = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `image_type` (String) e.g. "Operating System".
- `name` (String)
- `operating_system` (String)
- `operating_system_version` (String)
- `os_type_id` (String) UUID of the operating system type.
- `url` (String) URL the ISO file is downloaded from.

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset.
- `description` (String)
- `is_bootable` (Boolean)
- `is_extractable` (Boolean)
- `password_enabled` (Boolean)
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used in the delete endpoint's path and for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_iso.example <iso-slug>
```
